text_block_list.text:
Mr. C.B. and Symboli Rudolf returned from 
a photoshoot for a racing silk feature in 
a magazine.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Mhm-mhm, this racing outfit really is 
great. It completely fits every movement 
and pose!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I am glad to hear that. The clouds have 
parted after the rain; for a time, the 
design refused to take shape, and I 
worried how it would turn out.

Symboli Rudolf's words reminded me of the 
time we decided on the design of her 
racing silks—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Huh. The draft for the racing silks 
arrived. What's it look like?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Um, how should I put this... It's pretty 
flashy, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Flashy yet grandiose—I see. I suppose it's 
the physical embodiment of the public's 
expectations for the Umamusume named Mr. 
C.B.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Doesn't that feel kind of off-brand 
for me, though?
choice_data_list:
It's still just at the draft stage, so we 
can iron out the details.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Got it. Let's go think about it 
over at those seats.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
By the way, C.B., didn't you submit any 
design requests? I think doing so would 
have prevented any misunderstandings.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Even when you tell me you're making 
a Racewear, it just doesn't really click 
for me, you know?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Why go through the trouble of making 
costumes in the first place? Wouldn't gym 
clothes be fine?
choice_data_list:
The significance of a racing outfit, 
huh...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, then would you like to experience it 
firsthand? Rather than piling on words, 
it'll be faster for you to feel it 
yourself.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Let's have a match, Mr. C.B. I'll be in 
my racing silks, and you in your gym 
clothes."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Taaaaahhhh!!

As always, the two put on a breathtaking 
performance that captivated every 
spectator. Just like old times, it 
remained a fiercely contested battle, but—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Ngh...... Aaaaaaaah!!!

The victor at the very end was Symboli 
Rudolf, who showed the sheer momentum to 
hold off Mr. C.B.'s closing charge.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
...Rudolf's running was different from 
usual. Her spirit, the way her feet 
gripped the ground... why?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The answer to that connects back to your 
earlier question about the true meaning 
and purpose of a racing outfit.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
What do you mean? Why are racing silks 
coming up here?
choice_data_list:
Maybe it's because your racing outfit is 
the source of your power?

Let's face our winning outfit to find the 
answer.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Is that so, Rudolf?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. To me, a racewear is proof of the 
honors I've earned and the trust I've 
built up over time, after all.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Every time I run in my racing silks, I 
remember. The voices of those cheering for 
me in anticipation, and the pride I felt 
whenever I seized victory.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"It gives me courage knowing there is no 
mistake in my ideals or the path I've 
walked. That becomes even greater power, 
making me stronger."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: "Hmm? Hmm..."
choice_data_list:
In Mr. C.B.'s case, maybe it's the memory 
of running happily.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: What do you mean?

I tell her that maybe her Racewear is what 
makes her feel that way—wanting to run 
further, wanting to run faster. At that—

I tell her that maybe your Racewear is 
what makes her feel that way—wanting to 
run further, wanting to run faster. At 
that—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. In that case, it might be good.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, let's meet up at the cafe later! 
I'll brainstorm some ideas for my Racewear 
design.

Afterward—despite a few twists and turns 
along the way, we were able to create a 
Racers that reflected Mr. C.B.'s wishes, 
leading up to today.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Hey, let's run like we did back then, 
Rudolf! This time, the two of us in our 
racing silks.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
And next time, I'm the one who's gonna 
win.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
You're on. Let me assess the power of you 
and your racing silks once more.

Win or lose, it will surely be a 
magnificent contest. With that conviction 
in mind, I followed behind the girls as 
they headed to the grounds.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: With your racewear?
choice_data_list:
Let's revise the design until you're 
satisfied with it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
That would be wise. You should think about 
what kind of outfit you'd want to run and 
be in alongside.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"Together," huh... Maybe it's someone who 
accepts me for who I am, telling me it's 
okay to just be free.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Effortlessly, before I knew it, she was 
there giving me a push forward—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, I think I kind of get it now.

For a moment, I thought Mr. C.B. glanced 
my way. But after a blink, her gaze was 
fixed on Symboli Rudolf.

Afterward—despite a few twists and turns 
along the way, we were able to create a 
Racers that reflected Mr. C.B.'s wishes, 
leading up to today.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Hey, let's run like we did back then, 
Rudolf! This time, the two of us in our 
racing silks.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
And next time, I'm the one who's gonna 
win.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
You're on. Let's see if you've truly found 
your answer.

Win or lose, it will surely be a 
magnificent contest. With that conviction 
in mind, I followed behind the girls as 
they headed to the grounds.
